 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Chicago Fire host Orlando City SC at Soldier Field today as Gregg Berhalter's side come into this fixture having already booked their postseason ticket. 
 They currently sit 4th in the conference and are looking to secure a top-four seed to guarantee home-field advantage. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Meanwhile, Martín Perelman's side are currently clinging to the 7th and final automatic playoff spot, ahead of FC Cincinnati thanks to a total victories tiebreaker.
 In their head to head record, Chicago Fire have won their last three matches against Orlando City with their most recent meeting in August ending in a 2-1 victory for the Fire.
 This matchup also marks a meeting between Robert Lewandowski and Antoine Griezmann, both of whom joined the MLS this season. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Antoine Griezmann celebrates with teammate Iván Angulo during the MLS match between San Jose Earthquakes and Orlando City.
 Comparing the two, Griezmann has clearly been in better form having scored 13 goals so far while Lewandowski has managed six goals so far. The Frenchman is also on an 11-match streak with a goal contribution and has looked unstoppable so far.
 Chicago Fire vs. Orlando City Official Lineups
 Chicago Fire:
 Goalkeeper: Brady
 Defenders: Barroso, Hanche-Olsen, Elliott, Gutman
 Midfielders: Oregel Jr., Mekvabishvili, Salétros
 Forwards: Zinckernagel, Lewandowski, Haile-Selassie
 Orlando City:
 Goalkeeper: Crépeau
 Defenders: Iago, Nogueira, Ellis, Luís Otávio
 Midfielders: B. Ojeda, Angulo, Ojeda
 Forwards: Taifi, Brekalo, Griezmann
 Start Time & How to Watch Chicago Fire vs. Orlando City
 The primary option to watch tonight's MLS match is Apple TV via the MLS Season Pass, which broadcasts the game without any local blackout restrictions.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The match kicks off at 8:30 PM EDT.
